course.title: Water Resources Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A reservoir with a surface area of 250 hectares had the following average value of parameters during a week: Water temperature= 20°c, relative humidity= 40%, wind velocity at 1.0 m above ground= 16 km/h. Estimate the average daily evaporation from the lake and value of water evaporated from the lake during that week.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
